about: hark bank catalogue: the built-in category table, the measured target row of every shipped id, and the forge04 members. Data for category_info, build --forge04 and build --derive.

click.use: button presses and cursor clicks: a short tuned tick with a little body

pro_click.target: a sharp, high-pitched digital tick for a product demo

hover_tick.target: a tiny, soft, high tick as a cursor moves over a button
hover_tick.use: cursor hover, rows going past, very small ticks

pro_hover_tick.target: a very small, breathy digital tick for an animated interface
pro_hover_tick.use: light, breathy digital ticks for counters and blinking cursors

tap.target: a soft, low thump of a finger on a screen
tap.use: a finger on a screen or a light touch on a surface

pro_tap.target: a soft, low thump of a finger on a screen
pro_tap.use: one touch on glass: a soft, low thump

toggle.target: a small switch that turns on with two fast clicks
toggle.use: switches, settings toggles, things that lock in (a press, then a latch)

pop.use: bubble pops and cork pops (the bubble's pitch goes up)

pro_pop.use: tuned pops for a word or a badge that appears

pro_pop_in.target: a gentle, round, low pop when an icon shows up
pro_pop_in.use: icons or elements popping onto the screen: a round, low thump

notify.target: a struck bell chime for a notification
notify.use: chimes of a struck bell, A4 to E6: success, a message, a lockup

pro_notify.use: short, clean dings, one semitone apart

shimmer.target: bar chimes and wind chimes that ring out
shimmer.use: chimes that ring out, for end-card sparkle

whoosh_fast.target: a fast, crisp whoosh of air
whoosh_fast.use: fast camera whips, quick fly-ins, moving elements

whoosh_big.target: a large, deep whoosh for a transition
whoosh_big.use: large scene transitions, large objects that go past

pro_whoosh_big.target: a deep, low, designed whoosh swell
pro_whoosh_big.use: a designed swell of low sub energy that leads into a cut

swish.target: a thin, fast swish of a cane in the air
swish.use: thin, fast flicks, text that slides, small interface moves

swipe.use: swipes of cards and panels, page turns (cloth, paper)

riser.target: a film riser that builds tension up to a hit
riser.use: a build up to a reveal. The forge members stop on their loudest sample.

pro_riser.target: a brief digital riser that stutters up to a cut
pro_riser.use: a short, stuttering riser into a cut

downlifter.target: a downlifter: a filtered sweep that sinks
downlifter.use: energy that falls away after a hit, a scene exit

pro_zip.target: a fast, tuned zip: a quick synth pitch sweep
pro_zip.use: tuned sweeps across a cut (the `up`, `up_hi` and `arc` members go up in pitch)

impact.use: a film hit for a reveal or a title slam. The tails are 3-6 s long: trim with `dur` or `max_s`.

pro_impact.target: a deep, designed sub impact with a grainy rumble tail, gated
pro_impact.use: a designed sub impact with a gated end (0.7-1.3 s)

sub_drop.use: low weight beneath a hit, or a drop in the music

pro_sub_drop.target: a designed sub drop: a low sine that falls under a bright click
pro_sub_drop.use: a designed low drop that swells after the cut

logo_sting.target: a short, bright logo sting: a whoosh that lands on a hit, then a shimmering chime
logo_sting.use: a logo reveal in layers (a lead-in, a hit, a chime)

pro_logo_sting.target: a designed logo sting: a falling chirp that lands on a low hum
pro_logo_sting.use: designed launch gestures that land on a tone

glitch.target: a short digital glitch: crushed noise bursts that get faster and then stop

pro_glitch.target: a short digital glitch: crushed noise bursts that get faster and then stop
pro_glitch.use: a designed stutter that ends on the cut

typing_key.target: one mechanical key press: a crisp click and a short thock
typing_key.use: real-sounding mechanical keys, one take for each character

pro_typing_key.target: one brief digital key tick, high-passed and crisp, for a motion-graphics title
pro_typing_key.use: designed, high-passed ticks for animated type

pro_typing_run.target: a quick burst of high-passed digital key ticks for a title that types itself
pro_typing_run.use: a full typed run in one file

cut_hit.target: a brief, deep sub-bass hit layered with a kick drum
cut_hit.use: on a cut, either a brief sub hit with a kick or a brief punchy hit (0.2-0.5 s)

reverse_swell.use: a reverse cymbal or reverse swell with its peak just after a cut (one per film at most)

ui_pop.target: a soft, round pop, a small interface bubble
ui_pop.use: soft, round, mid-register pops for things that arrive: chips, bubbles, rows

knock.target: a knock on a wood block
knock.use: wood and plastic knocks in the mid band (0.1-0.2 s)

mallet.use: brief gated notes struck with a mallet (glockenspiel, celesta, marimba), a soft pluck, quick chime runs

drip.target: a drop of water that falls into water
drip.use: drops of water: a bubble whose pitch goes up (the audit lets a drip climb, part 2, 3.9)

shutter.use: camera shutters: a mechanical click in two stages, for snap zooms and whip cuts

pluck.target: one plucked kalimba tine (a thumb piano)
pluck.use: tuned kalimba-tine notes for bells, motifs and a tonal lockup

fit.use: a sound made by fitting a model to a public-domain recording

cut_hit/air.notes: a fast, wide sub hit with a bright band of air that holds over it

cut_hit/kick.notes: a sub hit led by its kick. The beater lifts the centroid to about 275 Hz.

cut_hit/punch.notes: a short punchy hit for a cut, about 0.28 s, with most energy under 150 Hz

cut_hit/rumble.notes: a kick over a slowly falling sub that opens into a wide, grainy rumble, 1.4 s

cut_hit/sub.notes: a short sub hit gliding from 225 Hz to 46 Hz, layered under a kick and a low punch

drip/bloop.notes: the slow bloop of a large drop (about 420 Hz): about 5 st over 0.10-0.15 s. This member is why the drip allowance exists.

drip/bubble.notes: a lower bubble (about 255 Hz) that climbs 10 st, followed by a smaller bubble

drip/drop.notes: a drop of water: a bubble at about 306 Hz that climbs 8 st in 40 ms, with a soft start

drip/plink.notes: a small, high plink (about 690 Hz) that climbs 3 st

drip/tiny.notes: a very small, fast droplet at about 1.15 kHz, 0.1 s

glitch/burst.notes: crackle, then bright bursts. The first burst is the loudest and the bursts get faster.

glitch/chirp.notes: a stutter of tuned data chirps whose first burst is the loudest

glitch/mid.notes: a short glitch in the mid band whose first burst is the loudest

knock/desk.notes: knuckles on a desk: a low wooden knock over the body of the table

knock/double.notes: two knocks on wood, 55 ms apart

knock/plastic.notes: a plastic click at about 2.4 kHz with a bounce 18 ms after it

knock/snap.notes: a gentle touch followed by a bright snap of plastic (about 3 kHz) that bounces

knock/wood.notes: a mid-band knock on wood: a block at about 400 Hz and a faint rattle

mallet/celesta.notes: a wide, gated celesta note at G5 (correlation about 0.5)

mallet/flourish.notes: a fast chime figure of three notes that go up and down, almost mono

mallet/glock.notes: a gated glockenspiel note with a second voice one octave lower, about 0.35 s

mallet/marimba.notes: a short, dry marimba note on wood at G4

mallet/pluck.notes: a soft, low pluck, like a felt hammer

mallet/up4.notes: four gated chime notes that skip up a pentatonic scale, 110 ms apart, each note panned to its own place

notify/mid_tine.notes: a round mid ding: a tine struck with felt, over its octave (about 690 Hz, 32 ms to the peak)

notify/mid_wood.notes: a soft wood bar with a body one octave down, one step higher than mid_tine

reverse_swell/breath.notes: a reverse breath of noise in the mid band (about 1.3 kHz), half wide

reverse_swell/cymbal.notes: a bright, wide reverse cymbal. After the peak it holds a short plateau, then stops.

reverse_swell/dark.notes: a darker reverse swell, almost mono, with a low body

reverse_swell/ring.notes: a reverse cymbal with a stronger swell that rings out after the peak

reverse_swell/short.notes: a brief, bright reversed cymbal for a quick cut, peaking at 0.33 s

riser/build.notes: a build heavy in sub, with crackle and a gate that gets faster (about 1.1 s)

riser/dark.notes: a short, dark riser of noise, sub and a stutter that gets faster. It has no synth sweep.

riser/snatch.notes: a stutter of half a second that pulls into a cut

shutter/dslr.notes: a camera shutter: the latch, 39 ms of curtain travel, then the landing on a box tuned near 1.4 kHz

shutter/film.notes: a heavier film camera: 95 ms of travel into a dark-sounding box, a body thump, a rattling spring

shutter/mirror.notes: a slower mirror-box shutter whose travel you can hear

shutter/quick.notes: two fast clicks: the release first, the curtain 21 ms later

shutter/snap.notes: a dry, bright shutter at about 2 kHz for a snap zoom

swish/bright.notes: a fast, bright swish (centroid about 2.4 kHz)

swish/flick.notes: a high, wide flick that goes up and stops at once

ui_pop/blip.notes: a bright blip at about 890 Hz. The two channels are almost unrelated (L/R correlation about 0.1).

ui_pop/fall.notes: an eased fall of 7 st, then a quiet second pop

ui_pop/soft.notes: a soft, round mid pop at about 550 Hz: 22 ms to its peak, down 20 dB after 75 ms

ui_pop/step.notes: the soft pop one step higher, with a 3 st fall

ui_pop/wide.notes: a wide pop at about 620 Hz with a small lip click (correlation about 0.5)

whoosh_big/thump.notes: a large, low whoosh that lands on a thump about 80 ms in, which rings for about 0.35 s

whoosh_big/thump_airy.notes: an airier version of the thump whoosh

whoosh_big/thump_deep.notes: a deeper, longer version of the thump whoosh

whoosh_fast/whip.notes: a designed, bright whip whose wide ring drops about 45 st
